restore_policy: Recover exact source bytes only after explicit review; no automatic restoration or activation.
known_test_issue: The zero-seed allocation address moves when packing is hoisted. Comparing raw MVIN3 source pointers in the draft test is therefore not a valid semantic assertion; exact zero provenance and output extent must be compared before any test/admission claim.
wider_transfers: Not implemented: selected raw load supports multi-block columns, but the original packet owner limits load cols to DIM. A distinct explicitly selected ownership protocol is required.
